description:
`jit item` resolves markdown-first item sources by reading the files live (`crates/jit/src/commands/item.rs:332`, via `IssueStore::read_repo_file`), while registry-first sources come from the captured image. A concurrent `jit project render`, which rewrites generated regions in those markdown files, can make one query combine a captured registry with markdown bytes from a different moment.

## Background

Registry-first item kinds (gate, rule, invariant) read their TOML sources from the captured image as of commit `90862f758`. Markdown-first kinds still read live because the image capture does not include their source documents.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit item` show, list and search resolve markdown-first item sources from the same captured image as registry-first sources; no item query reads a source file outside its capture.
- [hard] REQ-02: The capture includes exactly the markdown sources the configured item kinds declare, derived from `[item_kinds]` in repository configuration.
- [hard] REQ-03: One test owns the property that an item query's markdown and registry content come from one captured image.

## Notes

Surfaced by the worker of the registry-first item-query task under the mutation-session epic; kept out of that epic because its criteria name declarations only. Relevant: @/charter/D-22, @/inv/convention-convergence.
title: Item queries read markdown-first sources from the captured image
